summary: Unauthenticated MCP HTTP stays on loopback by default, and learned resource prefixes treat percent, underscore, and backslash as literal identifier data.
reason: The generated HTTP server otherwise exposed authenticated eero and local-learning tools on every interface, while prefix verification could treat synchronized lookup characters as SQL LIKE wildcards and return a different resource.
validated_outcome: Loopback address coverage and a wildcard-identifier prefix regression test pass with the full Go test, vet, and build suites.
